brief: Design a rigid upper-arm exoskeleton side rail, 180 mm long, 30 mm wide, and 8 mm thick, with rounded edges. Include two 8.2 mm diameter mounting holes spaced 60 mm apart for connection to the biceps plate, and one 8.2 mm diameter pivot hole centered 15 mm from the lower end for the elbow hinge. Reinforce the pivot region with a circular boss 30 mm in diameter and 12 mm total thickness. Keep the structure lightweight with rounded triangular cutouts while maintaining continuous material around every hole.

requirements.statement: The overall length of the side rail shall be 180 mm.
requirements.rationale: Brief states the rail is 180 mm long.

requirements.statement: The overall width of the side rail shall be 30 mm.
requirements.rationale: Brief states the rail is 30 mm wide.

requirements.statement: The overall thickness of the side rail at its thickest point (the pivot boss) shall be 12 mm.
requirements.rationale: The boss gives the rail a total thickness of 12 mm at the pivot region, which is the tallest feature of the finished part in Z; the base rail is 8 mm thick elsewhere.

requirements.statement: The base rail plate shall be 8 mm thick away from the pivot boss.
requirements.rationale: Brief states the rail is 8 mm thick.

requirements.statement: Each mounting hole shall be 8.2 mm in diameter.
requirements.rationale: Brief states two 8.2 mm diameter mounting holes.

requirements.statement: The two mounting holes shall be spaced 60 mm apart.
requirements.rationale: Brief states mounting holes spaced 60 mm apart.

requirements.statement: The pivot hole shall be 8.2 mm in diameter.
requirements.rationale: Brief states one 8.2 mm diameter pivot hole.

requirements.statement: The pivot hole shall be centered 15 mm from the lower end of the rail.
requirements.rationale: Brief states the pivot hole is centered 15 mm from the lower end.

requirements.statement: The circular boss reinforcing the pivot region shall be 30 mm in diameter.
requirements.rationale: Brief states the boss is 30 mm in diameter.

requirements.statement: The pivot boss shall give a total thickness of 12 mm at the pivot region.
requirements.rationale: Brief states the boss has 12 mm total thickness.

requirements.statement: The rail shall have exactly two mounting holes for connection to the biceps plate.
requirements.rationale: Brief specifies two mounting holes.

requirements.statement: The rail shall have exactly one pivot hole for the elbow hinge.
requirements.rationale: Brief specifies one pivot hole.

requirements.statement: The rail shall include at least one rounded triangular cutout for weight reduction.
requirements.rationale: Brief calls for rounded triangular cutouts (plural implies at least two, but exact count and geometry are not specified); at least one is required to satisfy the lightweighting intent.

requirements.statement: The part shall have 3 open holes of 8.2 mm.
requirements.rationale: The brief sizes and counts these holes.

assumptions.statement: A minimum edge-to-hole and cutout-to-hole material margin of approximately 5 mm (or at least one hole diameter) is maintained around every hole, consistent with the brief's 'continuous material around every hole' requirement.
assumptions.rationale: The brief requires continuous material around holes but gives no numeric margin; a conventional minimum edge distance of roughly one hole diameter is a common structural design guideline.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If the actual required margin differs substantially, the rail could be locally over-weakened near a hole or unnecessarily heavy.

assumptions.statement: The 8.2 mm pivot and mounting holes are plain clearance holes with no bushing, bearing insert, or sleeve specified; any bearing surface is provided by a separate, unspecified pivot pin/bushing assembly not part of this component.
assumptions.rationale: Brief does not mention a bushing or bearing insert; absent that information, holes are modeled as simple through-holes.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If a bushing or press-fit sleeve was intended, the hole geometry and local wall thickness would need to change.

assumptions.statement: The 'rounded edges' called out in the brief are a modest cosmetic/safety fillet (on the order of 1-2 mm radius) along the rail's perimeter edges, not a structural feature with a specified value.
assumptions.rationale: Brief states rounded edges but gives no radius; a small fillet is the conventional interpretation for edge-break/deburring and skin-contact comfort on a wearable part.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: A larger or smaller radius than assumed would change the part's exact envelope only marginally and is low consequence.

assumptions.statement: The number, exact size, and placement pattern of the rounded triangular cutouts are left to the designer's discretion, subject to maintaining continuous material around every hole and the rail's overall envelope; at least one cutout is provided for lightweighting.
assumptions.rationale: Brief specifies the cutout shape intent (rounded triangular, weight reduction) but not their count, size or exact location.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: If a specific count or pattern was intended, the lightweighting target or aesthetic may not be met, but structural integrity is not compromised by this assumption alone.

assumptions.statement: Unresolved at design time: What material (and grade/temper) should the rail be made from? No value was supplied and none was invented.
assumptions.rationale: Material properties (yield strength, stiffness, fatigue life) are required to verify the rail under any load, and this is a safety-relevant wearable component where guessing a grade would be invented data.
assumptions.consequence_if_wrong: Any conclusion depending on this is unfounded. It blocks: the design as a whole.

unknowns.question: What material (and grade/temper) should the rail be made from?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Material properties (yield strength, stiffness, fatigue life) are required to verify the rail under any load, and this is a safety-relevant wearable component where guessing a grade would be invented data.

unknowns.question: Is there a specific minimum edge-to-hole / cutout-to-hole material margin required beyond the qualitative 'continuous material around every hole' statement?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Without a numeric value, the local material margin around holes and cutouts is a designer assumption rather than a checkable requirement, which matters for the structural integrity of a load-bearing pivot region.

unknowns.question: Does the pivot hole require a bushing, bearing, or sleeve insert, and if so what are its material and tolerance requirements?
unknowns.why_it_matters: This changes the hole's fit class, local wall thickness needs, and wear/fatigue behavior at the elbow hinge interface.

document.name: Upper-arm exoskeleton side rail
document.description: Rigid side rail linking a biceps-mounting plate (two mounting holes) to an elbow hinge pivot (one hole, locally reinforced by a circular boss), with rounded triangular cutouts for weight reduction.

parameters.description: Assumed cosmetic/safety edge break; brief gives no value (ASM_ROUNDED_EDGE_RADIUS)
Distance from the upper end to the midpoint of the mounting hole pair; placement choice not given by brief
Boss height added on top of the base plate to reach the stated total thickness
Assumed minimum continuous-material margin around holes/cutouts (ASM_EDGE_MARGIN)
Middle cutout centered along the rail between mounting holes and pivot boss

interfaces.description: Elbow hinge pivot; mates with a pivot pin/bushing assembly not part of this component (ASM_NO_BUSHING)
Upper face adjacent to the mounting holes, flat to mate with the biceps plate
